subject: part
title: (R)PART.------AF.DYM.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-40, at the close of the passage where Braxton introduces the *affinity insight (1) and (2) principles*: AFI(1) as 'affirmation' — the agent that 'dictates how transformation is to be arrived at (if a given situation is out of phase with its own “essence factor” in a given phase)' — and AFI(2) as 'celebration' — the vibrational flow that 'moves towards “composite knowingness” on the physical plane.' (R)PART — the reality of participation — is crossed with AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). The diagram poses what *real* participation, not symbolic or token participation, requires structurally to align with affinity dynamics. PART's main line runs to AFL-DY, which branches to (PO)TH-CONT — the *point of* thrust continuance, using Braxton's (PO) prefix from the CODE notation — and to PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance); TH-CONT branches to PRI-INFO (principle information). PROJ-CONT runs to AFL (affinity alignment), which branches to (C)RC (the concept of race) and (R)POST (the reality of postulation). The structural argument: real participation is not voluntaristic — through affinity dynamics it reaches both the point of thrust continuance and projectional continuance, whose affinity alignment opens onto race and postulation. Race appears here as a *conceptual* node (the (c) prefix), not a primary thing — Braxton's diagrammatic insistence that race is a concept emerging from projectional continuance, not a precondition of it.
